caption: The drawing depicts a single metal teapot, centrally positioned on a plain, off-white background. The teapot has a wide base, a conical body that tapers toward the top, and a rounded lid with a small knob on top. The spout is long, thin, and curves upward sharply, extending to the left. The handle, located on the right, is large and rounded, with a smooth, continuous curve. On the main body of the teapot, there is an engraved decorative motif featuring a symmetrical floral design with a central tulip and two side flowers emerging from a small base or pot. The entire image is rendered in grayscale, using precise and delicate shading to create a realistic metallic appearance and subtle three-dimensional effect. There are faint decorative patterns along the bottom section and around the middle of the teapot. In the top right corner is a vertical stamp or label that reads "MUEBLES," and near the bottom right, there is a faint signature: "Samuel O. Klein." The drawing is finely detailed, with attention given to texture and form.
title: Pa. German Coffee Pot
